# Distribusi Variabel Random
```{r}
# Rata-rata pesanan per jam (lambda) 
lambda <- 4 

# 1. P(X = 5) 
P_X_5 <- dpois(5, lambda) 
P_X_5

# 2. P(X < 3) 
P_X_less_3 <- ppois(2, lambda) # Ingat bahwa P(X < 3) sama dengan P(X ≤ 2) 
P_X_less_3

# 3. Mencari a dengan P(X < a) = 0.8 (inverse) 
a <- qpois(0.8, lambda) 
a
```
```{r}
# Z-score 90%
z_90 <- qnorm(0.9)
z_90

# Z-score 95%
z_95 <- qnorm(0.95)
z_95

# Z-score 99%
z_99 <- qnorm(0.99)
z_99
```

```{r}
# Chi-Square tabel dengan df = 4 dan alpha = 0.05
chi_tabel = qchisq(0.95, df = 4)
chi_tabel
```

```{r}
# Buat nilai Z dari -3.4 hingga 3.4 dengan interval 0.1
z_values <- seq(-3.4, 3.4, by = 0.1)

# Hitung probabilitas kumulatif untuk setiap nilai Z menggunakan fungsi pnorm
z_table <- data.frame(
  Z = z_values,
  P = pnorm(z_values)
)

# Cetak tabel Z
print(z_table)
```

# Visualisasi Distribusi

```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Generate data using binomial distribution
data <- rbinom(100, size = 10, prob = 0.5)

# Create a histogram
hist(data, breaks = 10, col = "lightblue", border = "black",
     main = "Histogram of Binomial Distribution",
     xlab = "Values", ylab = "Frequency",
     xlim = c(0, 10), ylim = c(0, 30))

# Optional: add grid lines for better visualization
grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted")

```
```{r}
# Generate data using binomial distribution
data <- rbinom(100, size = 10, prob = 0.5)

# Create a dot plot (stripchart) with ylim starting from 0
stripchart(data, method = "stack", pch = 16, col = "blue", 
           main = "Dot Plot of Binomial Distribution", 
           xlab = "Values", ylab = "Frequency", 
           ylim = c(0, 100))

# Optional: add grid lines for better visualization
grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted")

```

```{r}
# Generate random normal data
data <- rnorm(1000, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Plot histogram
hist(data, 
     breaks = 30,  # Number of bins
     col = "lightblue",  # Color of bars
     main = "Histogram of Normal Distribution",
     xlab = "Values",
     probability = TRUE)  # Use probability density instead of frequency

# Add a density curve to the histogram
lines(density(data), col = "red", lwd = 2)

```
```{r}
# Generate random normal data
data <- rnorm(1000, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Plot density
plot(density(data), 
     main = "Density Plot of Normal Distribution", 
     xlab = "Values", 
     col = "darkgreen", 
     lwd = 2)

```
# Transformasi Distribusi Variabel Random 

```{r}
set.seed(123)
bangkit.eksponensial = function(n, lambda){
  set.seed(123)
  U = runif(n, 0, 1)
  x = -1/lambda*log(1-U)
  return(x)
}
bangkit.eksponensial(10, 4)

```
```{r}
bangkit.eksponensial = function(n, lambda){
  set.seed(123)
  U = runif(n, 0, 1)
  x = -1/lambda*log(1-U)
  return(x)
}
bangkit.eksponensial(10, 4)
```
```{r}
data = bangkit.eksponensial(10, 4)
ks.test(data, 'pexp', 4)
```
```{r}
set.seed(123)
bangkit.diskrit=function(n){
  U=runif(n,0,1)
  x=NULL
  
  for(i in 1:n){
    if(U[i]<=0.1){
      x[i]=1
    }
    else if(U[i]>0.1 && U[i]<=0.5){
      x[i]=2
    }
    else if(U[i]>0.5 && U[i]<=0.7){
      x[i]=3
    }
    else{
      x[i]=4
    }
  }
  return(x)
}

data = bangkit.diskrit(100)
data

```
```{r}
barplot(prop.table(table(data)), main = "Empirical PMF")
```




````{r}

# Distribusi Levy
levy_pdf <- function(x, c, mu=0) {
  ifelse(x > mu,
         sqrt(c / (2 * pi)) * exp(-c / (2 * (x - mu))) / ((x - mu)^(3/2)),
         0)
}

# Buat vektor x
x <- seq(0.01, 5, length.out = 500)

# Tiga variasi c
c_values <- c(0.5, 1, 2)

# Plot
plot(x, levy_pdf(x, c_values[1]), type="l", col="red", lwd=2,
     ylim=c(0,2), xlab="x", ylab="f(x)",
     main="Distribusi Lévy (μ = 0, variasi c)")
lines(x, levy_pdf(x, c_values[2]), col="blue", lwd=2)
lines(x, levy_pdf(x, c_values[3]), col="green", lwd=2)

legend("topright", legend=paste("c =", c_values),
       col=c("red","blue","green"), lwd=2)

````

````{r}

# Fungsi pembangkit random Weibull menggunakan inverse transform
rweibull_custom <- function(n, alpha, beta) {
  U <- runif(n) # uniform(0,1)
  X <- ((-log(1 - U)) / alpha)^(1 / beta)
  return(X)
}

# Jumlah sampel
n <- 100
alpha <- 1
beta_values <- c(1, 2, 3.5)

# Generate data
set.seed(123) # agar hasil reprodusibel
data_list <- lapply(beta_values, function(b) rweibull_custom(n, alpha, b))

# Plot perbandingan distribusi
hist(data_list[[1]], breaks=15, freq=FALSE, col=rgb(1,0,0,0.4),
     xlim=c(0,3), main="Weibull Distribution with α=1 and various β",
     xlab="x", ylab="Density")
hist(data_list[[2]], breaks=15, freq=FALSE, col=rgb(0,1,0,0.4), add=TRUE)
hist(data_list[[3]], breaks=15, freq=FALSE, col=rgb(0,0,1,0.4), add=TRUE)

legend("topright", legend=paste("β =", beta_values),
       fill=c(rgb(1,0,0,0.4), rgb(0,1,0,0.4), rgb(0,0,1,0.4)))

````
